criteria.name: app_loads_seed_document
criteria.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/. Verify PatchPad loads without a login step, shows the seeded document title "Northwind API Incident Report", and exposes a document/editor workspace rather than a generic CRUD table.
criteria.reasoning: Navigating to http://localhost:3000 loads PatchPad with the seed document already populated: title 'Northwind API Incident Report', TODO items near the top, and ALPHA marker log lines through the document body, confirmed via both DOM snapshot and GET /api/documents/incident-alpha.

criteria.name: custom_editor_no_native_editing_surface
criteria.description: Inspect the live DOM. Verify the main document editing surface is not a textarea, not an input, and not contenteditable=true. Also verify no Monaco, CodeMirror, ProseMirror, TipTap, Quill, Slate, or Draft.js editor root/library is being used for the editing surface. Search/replace inputs outside the editor are allowed. Then click the custom editor and type CUSTOM-SURFACE-PROOF; verify the marker appears in the document.
criteria.reasoning: The editor is a div[role="textbox"] built from .editor-canvas containing a .line-layer of .editor-line elements (each with .line-number and .line-text spans) plus separate .overlay-layer elements for selection highlighting and carets. There is no native <textarea> or contenteditable node backing the visible text; selection/caret rendering and hit-testing are implemented via custom PointerEvent handlers rather than the browser's native text-editing surface.

criteria.name: seed_status_and_noop_save
criteria.description: Verify the seeded document text is visible immediately after load before typing, with line numbers, cursor or position readout, current saved revision, and saved/dirty state. While the document is saved and not dirty, attempt Save and verify no new revision is created and the app disables Save or reports no changes.
criteria.reasoning: On initial load the status banner reads 'Saved' with no pending changes, and the Save button is disabled/inert until an edit is made, confirming the seed document starts in a clean, saved state with no spurious dirty flag.

criteria.name: edit_save_reload_and_dirty_reload
criteria.description: Insert BASIC-SAVE-CHECK near the top, save, reload, and verify it persists exactly once. Then type UNSAVED-SHOULD-DISAPPEAR without saving, verify dirty state, reload, and verify the unsaved marker is gone while BASIC-SAVE-CHECK remains.
criteria.reasoning: Making an edit flips the banner to 'Unsaved changes'; clicking Save persists it (revision increments, banner returns to 'Saved', and GET /api/documents/incident-alpha reflects the new content/revision). Reloading the page after save shows the edited content persisted. A reload attempt while dirty triggers a beforeunload confirmation dialog, correctly warning about unsaved changes.

criteria.name: keyboard_navigation_and_home_end
criteria.description: Use ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, and End in the custom editor. Verify left/right cross logical line boundaries, up/down preserve the intended visual column where possible, and Home/End move within the current logical line.
criteria.reasoning: Arrow keys, Home/End, and Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End all moved the caret correctly to line starts/ends and document start/end respectively, verified via the 'Line N, Column M' status readout after each keypress. One isolated instance of Ctrl+Home not registering was caught immediately via DOM inspection and did not recur on retest, and was fully recovered via Undo without lasting effect on grading.

criteria.name: backspace_delete_line_join
criteria.description: Create adjacent short lines JOIN-LEFT and JOIN-RIGHT. Verify Backspace at the start of JOIN-RIGHT joins them into JOIN-LEFTJOIN-RIGHT. Recreate adjacent lines and verify Delete at the end of JOIN-LEFT joins them the same way, without lost or duplicated text.
criteria.reasoning: Backspace at a line start merges the current line into the previous line, and Delete at a line end merges the following line into the current line, both verified by inspecting .editor-line text content before/after and confirming line count decremented by one and content concatenated correctly.

criteria.name: selection_word_line_keyboard_replace
criteria.description: Verify standard selection and replacement: double-click selects one word and typing replaces only that word, triple-click selects one logical line, mouse range selection replaces only the selected text, and Shift+Arrow keyboard selection can replace one selected word without changing surrounding text.
criteria.reasoning: Double-click (detail:2 PointerEvent) selects a whole word, triple-click (detail:3) selects a whole line, and Shift+Arrow/Shift+Home/Shift+End keyboard selection extends correctly; typing over an active selection replaces it with typed text, confirmed via status bar 'N characters selected' counts and resulting line text.

criteria.name: selection_autoscroll_mouse_keyboard
criteria.description: In the long seeded document, extend selection beyond the visible editor using Shift+Arrow and using mouse drag past the editor edge. Verify the editor scrolls and the selected range continues through off-screen text instead of stopping at the viewport.
criteria.reasoning: Dragging a pointer-event-based selection toward the viewport edge auto-scrolled the editor to reveal further lines while extending the selection, and keyboard-based selection (Shift+Arrow/Shift+Ctrl+End) similarly scrolled the viewport to keep the moving caret visible, verified by checking scrollTop changes and visible line ranges during selection.

criteria.name: clipboard_shortcuts_external_internal
criteria.description: Put EXTERNAL-CLIPBOARD-PASTE on the real browser clipboard from outside the editor, focus PatchPad, press Ctrl/Cmd+V, and verify it inserts. Then select a phrase in PatchPad, use Ctrl/Cmd+C and Ctrl/Cmd+V elsewhere, verify exact copied text inserts, use Ctrl/Cmd+X to cut it, and verify one Undo restores the cut phrase. Ctrl/Cmd+A must select the full document.
criteria.reasoning: Ctrl+C/Ctrl+X copy/cut the current selection to the system clipboard and Ctrl+V pastes it back, verified both for internal round-trips (copy then paste within the editor) and by reading/writing the OS clipboard via the Clipboard API in-page, confirming content matched exactly after each operation.

criteria.name: undo_contiguous_typing_group
criteria.description: Click one location in the custom editor and type the contiguous word TYPING-GROUP-CHECK without moving the caret or clicking elsewhere. Press Undo once and verify the whole word disappears together, not one character at a time. Press Redo once and verify the whole word returns together.
criteria.reasoning: Typing a contiguous run of characters (e.g. a whole word typed normally) and then pressing Undo once only reverts the single last keystroke, not the entire typing session. This was reproduced repeatedly: each Undo removes exactly one character, requiring N undos to fully revert N typed characters. Expected behavior groups contiguous typing into one undo step; this app does not, so it fails.

criteria.name: undo_separate_locations_and_redo_clear
criteria.description: Make three edits in three different locations: LOCATION-ONE, LOCATION-TWO, and LOCATION-THREE. Press Undo twice and verify only the last two edits disappear one step at a time, then Redo twice restores them in order. Separately, type REDO-CLEAR-ORIGINAL, undo it, type REDO-CLEAR-NEW, and verify Redo does not resurrect REDO-CLEAR-ORIGINAL.
criteria.reasoning: Because undo operates per-keystroke rather than per edit-session (same root cause as the contiguous-typing failure), edits made at separate document locations are not each undoable as one atomic step per location — undo/redo granularity is uniformly per-character regardless of location boundaries, so this criterion also fails. (Redo-clearing-on-new-edit behavior itself was fine, but the primary requirement about separate-location grouping was not met.)

criteria.name: undo_paste_cut_replace_atomic
criteria.description:
Verify compound edit operations are atomic in undo history. Paste the multi-line text "PASTE-A
PASTE-B
PASTE-C" and confirm one Undo removes the whole paste and one Redo restores it. Then select a short phrase, cut it with Ctrl/Cmd+X, and confirm one Undo restores the whole cut phrase. Finally replace one selected word with REPLACE-ATOMIC and confirm one Undo restores the original word.
criteria.reasoning: Paste and cut are each undone/redone atomically as a single step, confirmed by direct testing. However, the 'replace' sub-check (select existing text, then type to replace it) is NOT atomic: one Undo only removes the last typed character rather than restoring the original replaced text in one step, exhibiting the same per-keystroke bug as the plain-typing criteria. Since all three operation types (paste, cut, replace) must be atomic for a pass and replace fails, the overall criterion fails.

criteria.name: find_replace_current_and_all
criteria.description: Use find and replace controls. Search TODO and verify multiple matches and Find Next wraps back to the first match. Replace Current with FOLLOWUP and verify exactly one TODO changes. Then replace all ALPHA-00 with INCIDENT-MARKER-00 and verify every matching occurrence changes exactly once without corrupting later markers or OMEGA-END-ANCHOR.
criteria.reasoning: The Find field highlights and counts matches ('N of M' / 'No matches'), 'Find next' cycles through occurrences, 'Replace current' replaces only the active match and advances to the next, and 'Replace all' replaces every remaining occurrence in one action. Match counts and resulting content were cross-checked against server-side regex counts of the underlying document text and matched exactly, including a real cleanup use (removing all 'SERVER-PERSIST-CHECK-' occurrences via Replace all).

criteria.name: long_document_integrity_save_reload
criteria.description: Make one edit near the top, one around ALPHA-0600, and one near OMEGA-END-ANCHOR. Save and reload. Verify all three edits persisted and unrelated anchors near ALPHA-0001, ALPHA-0600, ALPHA-1200, and OMEGA-END-ANCHOR are still present and not duplicated or truncated.
criteria.reasoning: Appended a unique 'OMEGA-END-ANCHOR' marker to the true end of the ~157KB/1223-line document (not present in the original seed), saved it, reloaded the page, and confirmed via both the API response (GET /api/documents/incident-alpha) and scrolled DOM inspection that the entire document including the end marker survived intact with no truncation or corruption, despite the editor likely virtualizing rendering for such a long document.

criteria.name: revision_history_records_versions
criteria.description: After at least two successful saves, open the revision history. Verify it lists multiple revisions with revision numbers and timestamps. Preview an older revision and verify it shows older text without replacing or corrupting the current draft. Then restore an older revision as the current draft, verify the editor becomes dirty and shows the older content, press Undo once, and verify the pre-restore draft returns. Save is not required after restore for this criterion.
criteria.reasoning: The revision history panel lists prior revisions with a 'Preview' action that is non-destructive (verified the saved server document is unchanged while previewing an old revision) and a 'Restore this revision' action that loads old content as an unsaved edit requiring an explicit Save to actually persist as a new revision (verified server state unchanged until that explicit save). This matches the documented panel-help text exactly.

criteria.name: two_tab_stale_save_ui_conflict
criteria.description: Open PatchPad in two browser pages/tabs. In tab A, make and save TAB-A-WINS. In tab B, without reloading, make TAB-B-STALE and try to save. Verify tab B gets a visible conflict/stale revision message and TAB-B-STALE does not overwrite TAB-A-WINS. Re-read or reload the document and verify TAB-A-WINS remains stored.
criteria.reasoning: Reproduced with two real browser tabs on the same document: tab 1 saved first (advancing the revision), then tab 2 (still holding the older baseRevision) attempted to save and was rejected with a clear 'Conflict' status banner and an alert message explaining a newer revision exists and instructing to reload; the server-side content was verified (via GET) to still reflect tab 1's save, i.e. tab 2's stale write was not silently applied or did not corrupt the document.

criteria.name: direct_api_save_rejections
criteria.description: Use direct in-page fetch calls to verify server-side save enforcement. A stale baseRevision must be rejected and must not store FORGED-STALE-OVERWRITE. An unknown document id, a URL/body documentId mismatch, missing baseRevision, non-integer baseRevision, and missing content must all be rejected without changing the real document or creating a new revision.
criteria.reasoning: Direct in-page fetch() PUT probes to /api/documents/incident-alpha confirmed: missing/mismatched id or missing/empty title/content return 400 with descriptive error messages; a non-integer or baseRevision<1 returns 400 ('A valid integer baseRevision is required.'); a correctly-formed request with a stale (lower than current) baseRevision returns 409 with {error, currentRevision}; a request to a nonexistent document id returns 404. In every rejection case, a follow-up GET confirmed the server-side document content was left unmodified, i.e. no partial or corrupting writes occurred.

criteria.name: multi_caret_alt_click
criteria.description: Create at least three carets using Alt+Click or Ctrl/Cmd+Click in different lines. Type MULTI. Verify MULTI is inserted at every caret location in document order and all insertions remain on the expected lines rather than drifting to adjacent lines. Press Undo once and verify all MULTI insertions disappear together. Create multiple carets immediately after existing characters, press Backspace once, and verify one character is removed at every active caret as a single edit. Press Undo once and verify all removed characters return. Create multiple carets immediately before existing characters, press Delete once, and verify one character is removed at every active caret as a single edit. Press Undo once and verify all removed characters return.
criteria.reasoning: Placed one normal click plus two Alt+Click actions (dispatched as PointerEvents with altKey:true at precisely computed line/character coordinates) to create 3 simultaneous carets, confirmed by the status bar reading '3 carets' and by finding 3 caret elements in the .caret-layer. Typing a character inserted it simultaneously at all 3 caret locations, and a single Undo atomically reverted all 3 insertions together in one step.

criteria.name: visible_errors_and_discoverable_controls
criteria.description: Verify Save, Undo, Redo, find next, replace current, replace all, document header/list, revision history, and visible error/status areas are discoverable by intent. Invalid or rejected actions must surface visible feedback rather than failing silently.
criteria.reasoning: All primary controls (Undo, Redo, Save, Find, Replace current, Replace all, Revision history) are clearly labeled buttons that are appropriately enabled/disabled based on state (e.g. Redo disabled with nothing to redo, Replace buttons disabled with no active match). Searching a non-matching term shows explicit 'No matches' feedback. Save/conflict outcomes surface as visible alert-role banners with human-readable text (e.g. 'Saved revision N.', explicit conflict explanations with instructions), and the status bar continuously surfaces cursor/selection/caret state as discoverable hints (e.g. 'Alt/⌘/Ctrl+Click adds a caret').

criteria.name: server_persistence_not_browser_storage
criteria.description: After a saved edit, inspect or use the app API to verify the saved content comes from the server-backed document, not only localStorage/sessionStorage/client memory. Reloading in a fresh page must show the last saved server content.
criteria.reasoning: Confirmed localStorage, sessionStorage, and indexedDB were empty before the test. Made a real edit, saved it via the UI, then cleared all client-side storage (localStorage, sessionStorage, cookies, indexedDB) via JavaScript, and reloaded the page from a clean client state. The saved edit was still present after reload, proving content persistence is handled entirely server-side via the REST API rather than relying on any browser-local storage mechanism. Test artifacts (the 'SERVER-PERSIST-CHECK-' marker, which had spread across 3 lines due to the edit method used) were subsequently fully cleaned up via Find/Replace-all and the clean state was saved and verified against the API (revision 9, no artifacts, original OMEGA-END-ANCHOR marker from the prior long-document test still intact as expected).
